originals.citation: Arakawa, K., Hao, Q., et al. (2022). Early Identification of Student Struggles at the Topic Level Using Context-Agnostic Features. SIGCSE 2022.

quote: To address these issues and explore the extent to which we can replicate studies on this topic, this study replicated a recent study that explored identifying struggling students at the topic level using context-agnostic features.
notes: The abstract's description matches the title of @arakawa2022 verbatim; shared author (Hao). DOI from memory, unverified.
